description: Utility module for handling ANGLE graphics format conversions, including JSON loading, format parsing, and format-specific data initialization.

methods.name: get_angle_format_map_abs_path
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the 'angle_format_map.json' file located in the same directory as this script.

methods.name: reject_duplicate_keys
methods.description: Checks for duplicate keys in a list of key-value pairs and raises an error if duplicates are found.

methods.name: load_json
methods.description: Loads JSON data from a file, applying duplicate key rejection.

methods.name: load_forward_table
methods.description: Loads a JSON file and returns a dictionary mapping GL formats to ANGLE formats.

methods.name: load_inverse_table
methods.description: Loads a JSON file and returns a dictionary mapping ANGLE formats to GL formats.

methods.name: load_without_override
methods.description: Loads the default angle format mapping without overrides.

methods.name: load_with_override
methods.description: Loads the angle format mapping with an override JSON file.

methods.name: get_all_angle_formats
methods.description: Returns a list of all ANGLE format identifiers available.

methods.name: get_component_type
methods.description: Determines the component type (e.g., 'float', 'uint') from a format ID string.

methods.name: get_channel_tokens
methods.description: Extracts channel tokens (e.g., 'R8', 'G16') from a format ID string.

methods.name: get_channels
methods.description: Returns a string representing the channels (e.g., 'rgb', 'la') from a format ID.

methods.name: get_bits
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of channel bits (e.g., {'R':8, 'G':8}) from a format ID.

methods.name: get_format_info
methods.description: Returns component type, bits, and channels for a format ID.

methods.name: gl_format_channels
methods.description: Determines the GL channel layout string based on internal format name.

methods.name: get_internal_format_initializer
methods.description: Generates initialization code for internal formats based on format ID and internal format name.

methods.name: get_format_gl_type
methods.description: Returns the OpenGL type string (e.g., 'GLfloat', 'GLubyte') for a given format.

methods.name: get_vertex_copy_function
methods.description: Determines the appropriate vertex data copy function based on source and destination formats.
